scope: Isolated local inference; app choices, installed models and defaults unchanged
method: Warm median of five runs after a first transcription. Models loaded once per process. Final measured runs sequential after compilation/download finished. Early Small run during compilation excluded. Ultra transcribe_file includes file decoding, Whisper reads PCM before timing, Redux bench predecodes input. Device/backend/precision differ, so this compares tested configurations, not model-only speed.
limits: Only one Danish clip; no independently reviewed reference or WER
Small and Ultra text stable across six runs, not proof of broad accuracy
Load timings single observations affected by caching and runtime setup
Redux transcript reused from preceding probe, warm timings remeasured here
No cloud calls or audio uploads
No Windows/Linux/mobile runtime verification; no new app provider/default selected
